_comment: Raster-redesign eval suite config. All deck paths (source_pptx, ground_truth, source_pages_dir, fixtures_dir) are relative to a 'decks root' directory -- default the decks/ folder next to run_suite.py, overridable per-invocation with --decks-root or the RASTER_EVAL_DECKS_ROOT env var (see README.md). 'checker' selects which scoring tool run_suite.py score uses for this deck: 'ground_truth_checker' (exact python-pptx source text, precise wrong-number hard-fail) or 'checker' (OCR-based fixtures, for a deck with no exact python-pptx ground truth). This file intentionally ships with NO customer/large-external-reference-deck entry: add one to a private copy of this file (kept outside the repo) and pass it with --config, with --decks-root pointing at wherever its fixtures actually live.

decks.name: deck1_executive_report
decks.note: Synthetic EN deck built from a ppt-master executive-report template (docs/artifacts). No customer data. ground_truth.json + source_pages/ are checked in (the original source template isn't, so build_image_only_deck.py can't regenerate them); image_only.pptx is NOT checked in -- rebuild it with `build_image_only_deck.py --from-images` (see README.md).

decks.name: deck2_business_proposal
decks.note: Synthetic EN deck built from a ppt-master business-proposal template. No customer data. Same checked-in/rebuild split as deck1.

decks.name: deck3_data_journalism
decks.note: Synthetic EN deck built from an AI-capital data-journalism deck. No customer data. Same checked-in/rebuild split as deck1.

decks.name: deck4_korean_tables
decks.note: Fictional Korean deck with native tables, built for the fork's Korean UI/table coverage. No customer data. Nothing under decks/deck4_korean_tables/ is checked in -- it is fully regenerable from code: run decks/build_deck4.py then decks/build_image_only_deck.py (see README.md).
